package handler

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	db "GENRE_MODULE/db"
	friends "GENRE_MODULE/game/components/friends"
	playerentity "GENRE_MODULE/game/entities/player"
	sender "GENRE_MODULE/game/handler/syncsender"
	rules "GENRE_MODULE/game/modules/scenariorules"
	bots "GENRE_MODULE/loadtest"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
)

// 社交经营的夹具差异（genre-common/gameplay_test.go.txt 的约定）：没有房间，命令目标是主人 players[0] 自己，
// 农场是主人 PlayerDao.SocialFarm；访客 players[1] 是主人的好友（friends 模块），局外人 outsider 不是。

func newScenarioTarget(_ func(int64, entity.EntityKind) entity.IThreadSafeEntity, owner *playerentity.Player) entity.IThreadSafeEntity {
	return owner
}

// scenarioTargetKind：真实档里命令目标就是主人，不另建实体。
func scenarioTargetKind() (entity.EntityKind, entity.EntityCategory, bool) { return 0, 0, false }

func scenarioCollections() []string { return []string{db.PlayerDaoCollection} }

func registerScenario(*nest.NestMgr) error {
	RegisterScenarioNestHandlers()
	RegisterFriendsChangeNestHandlers()
	return nil
}

// open：主人申请、访客同意，两人成为好友（friends 的双边动作；以服务端身份调 Sender，两人的档都在本进程）。
func (e *scenarioEnv) open(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	change := sender.NewFriendsChangeSender(e.engine)
	owner, visitor := e.players[0].ID(), e.players[1].ID()
	if err := change.MultiSync_FriendsChange(ctx, owner, visitor, friends.FriendsApply); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := change.MultiSync_FriendsChange(ctx, visitor, owner, friends.FriendsAccept); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func (e *scenarioEnv) state(t *testing.T) rules.State {
	t.Helper()
	owner := e.players[0]
	s, err := rules.Load(scenarioRead(t, e, owner, func() string { return owner.Dao().GetSocialFarm() }), owner.ID())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return s
}

func (e *scenarioEnv) sendAs(p *playerentity.Player, c rules.Command) (rules.Result, error) {
	scenario := sender.NewScenarioSender(e.engine)
	if p == e.players[0] {
		return scenario.Sync_ScenarioOwn(context.Background(), p.ID(), c)
	}
	return scenario.MultiSync_ScenarioVisit(context.Background(), e.players[0].ID(), p.ID(), c)
}

func (e *scenarioEnv) targetFacts() []byte { return nil }
func (e *scenarioEnv) closeScenario()     {}

// 没有席位：冷加载后不用读回连接，也不用重连。
func (e *scenarioEnv) adopt(*testing.T)  {}
func (e *scenarioEnv) rejoin(*testing.T) {}

// scenarioSmoke：主人种植 → 同连接重发 → 换连接重发；都只提交一次。
func scenarioSmoke(t *testing.T, f *scenarioFixture) []bots.Step {
	t.Helper()
	c := f.command(t, 0, "plant")
	plant := bots.Step{Request: pb.ScenarioCommandRequest{RoomID: f.roomKey(), Seq: c.Seq, Revision: c.Revision, Kind: c.Kind}, Revision: 1}
	again := plant
	again.Reconnect = true
	return []bots.Step{plant, plant, again}
}
